hunks.purpose: The existing Candidate policy owner resolves the system key at its actual evaluation date
Unversioned Contract preset bytes cannot grant or remove a dated Candidate approval exemption
hunks.after:
-- R242 is a system-owned dated preset policy, never an Office choice.
  -- The Contract JSON is unversioned: a future apply/clear must not change
  -- approval for an earlier week, and a cloned/new Contract must resolve its
  -- own genuine membership. Re-resolve only this key from the native dated
  -- assignment. Preserve every ordinary manager-policy byte unchanged.
  v_manager_policy:=coalesce(v_values->'candidate_manager_approval_policy_json','{}'::jsonb)-'approval';
  select greatest(contract.start_date,v_date-6),least(contract.end_date,v_date)
  into v_fixed_from,v_fixed_to from public.contracts contract
  where contract.id=p_contract_id and contract.client_id=p_client_id
    and contract.weekly_timesheet_source::text='HEALTHROSTER'
    and contract.start_date<=v_date and contract.end_date>=v_date-6;
  if found
     and v_authority->>'configured_route'='HEALTHROSTER_WEEKLY_VALIDATION'
     and coalesce((v_authority#>>'{applicability,configuration_valid}')::boolean,false)
     and not coalesce((v_authority#>>'{applicability,import_authoritative}')::boolean,false) then
    select count(*) into v_agency_group_count
    from public.weekly_source_group_clients membership
    join public.weekly_source_groups source_group on source_group.id=membership.source_group_id
      and source_group.active and source_group.source_family='ROSTER'
      and source_group.environment=v_global.candidate_app_environment
    where membership.client_id=p_client_id
      and v_fixed_from>=membership.valid_from
      and v_fixed_to<=coalesce(membership.valid_to,'infinity'::date);
    if v_agency_group_count>1 then
      raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_GROUP_CARDINALITY_INVALID' using errcode='55000';
    elsif v_agency_group_count=1 then
      select source_group.id,source_group.agency_id,source_group.environment into strict v_agency_group
      from public.weekly_source_group_clients membership
      join public.weekly_source_groups source_group on source_group.id=membership.source_group_id
        and source_group.active and source_group.source_family='ROSTER'
        and source_group.environment=v_global.candidate_app_environment
      where membership.client_id=p_client_id
        and v_fixed_from>=membership.valid_from
        and v_fixed_to<=coalesce(membership.valid_to,'infinity'::date);
      if private.weekly_source_configured_agency_invoice_v1(
        p_client_id,v_agency_group.id,v_agency_group.agency_id,v_agency_group.environment,v_fixed_to
      ) is true then
        v_manager_policy:=v_manager_policy||jsonb_build_object('approval','NOT_REQUIRED');
      end if;
    end if;
  end if;
  v_email:=nullif(btrim(v_values->>'candidate_expense_invoice_email'),'');
